subject: re-doc
title: (R)RE.DOC.------POL.DY.
description: Chart on book p. 222 (T(IMP)M-20). RE-DOC (redocumentation) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; POL-DY (political dynamics) is the partner. From the subject: CN-INFO (controlled information) and TM (terminology—or terms of a definition), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From CN-INFO: EXT-CONT. From EXT-CONT: CULT-INFO-DY (culture information dynamics). From TM: PRIN-INFO and PROG-CONT (progressional continuance). From PRIN-INFO: PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics). From PROG-CONT: TRS (transition).
